description: Which part of the planned flight a NOTAM affects, the chip on its card: of the roles its field plays in the plan (the departure, a stop, the destination, the alternate filed), each it reaches, and whether it takes away a procedure that role flies (taken, the red chip) or is only the field's (the neutral one). Read from its card's own parts (notam_card), never its words: a departure procedure taken away (SID, ODP, DVA; AIM 5-2-9) reaches the departure and each stop, an arrival (STAR, AIM 5-4-1) or an approach (AIM 5-4-5) the destination, each stop and the alternate (14 CFR 91.169); what happened to the field itself (a runway closed, a light out, or a procedure NOTAM's own sentence closing a surface, FDC 6/3373's "RWY 18/36 PERMANENTLY CLSD") reaches every role there. A procedure NOTAM whose procedures it cannot name reaches the roles that fly its kind (JO 7930.2 1-2-1), neutral.

text.description: The NOTAM as sent, domestic or ICAO form.

idents.description: The field's idents (OSH, KOSH), as notam_card takes them.

roles.description: The roles the NOTAM's field plays in the planned flight, any order; empty where it plays none.

affects.description: Each role it reaches, those it takes a procedure from first, then departure, stop, arrival, alternate; the chip is the first. Empty where it reaches none.

taken.description: It takes away a procedure this role flies: the red chip; false, the field's own, the neutral one.
